description: Ask the user for a photo from one of their paired devices (usually their phone), for example of a label, a screen, an error message or a document. Their device shows your request with your reason; they take the photo there and it is saved here (default ./inbox). They may decline.

device.description: Name of a paired device (from list_devices). Optional when only one is paired.

folder.description: Where to save: a relative path inside the server's folder, with no folder starting with a dot. Default: inbox.

purpose.description: What you need and why, in one or two sentences the user reads on their device (at most 300 characters).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the user, 120 by default, at most 600.

name: request_photo
